title: fetch.py text --grep takes -i, so a case-insensitive census read is not refused with the usage text
goal: fetch.py text URL --grep PATTERN -i prints the lines that match case-insensitively and exits 1 when no line matches

run:
import functools,http.server,pathlib as P,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,threading d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());(d/"p.html").write_text("

Hello World

") h=functools.partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler,directory=str(d));srv=http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),h) threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever,daemon=True).start() u="http://127.0.0.1:%d/p.html"%srv.server_port p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/fetch.py","text",u,"--grep","hello","-i"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60) q=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/fetch.py","text",u,"--grep","nomatchzz","-i"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60) print(p.returncode,q.returncode,p.stdout[-100:],p.stderr[-120:]) sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and "Hello World" in p.stdout and q.returncode==1 else 1)

clauses.clause: fetch.py text URL --grep PATTERN -i prints the lines that match case-insensitively and exits 1 when no line matches

gates.question: What spelling does fetch.py text take for case-insensitive --grep?

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: fetch.py text URL --grep -i "licen|..." exited 2 with the usage text 6 times in one afternoon (10-23 14:35) of 117 fetch.py text calls; fetch.py:631 gives text its own parser with only --timeout, --grep and --header, and argparse reads -i as an unrecognized argument. Cheap fix. The planted run serves a local page and needs no network.
